personality_one_liner: A sharp, tactical, high-contrast command center designed for night shifts, fast scanning, and immediate operational response.

spacing.rule: Dense, tactical spacing for high data visibility, with generous padding only at screen roots and bottom sticky containers.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for elevation.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism. This is a rugged, performance-first utility app.

screens.name: Identificación (Login)
screens.purpose: Simple guard check-in by name without complex auth.

states.error: Error text below input if name is empty.

screens.layout: Top half contains the security logo and app title. Middle contains a single large text input for 'Nombre del Guardia'. A massive sticky CTA 'Iniciar Turno' anchored to the bottom.

screens.name: Panel de Control (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: Central operational hub displaying the real-time clock and immediate actions.

states.loading: Skeleton of the clock and action grid.
states.error: Alert banner at the top if offline.

screens.layout: Header: Guard name. Hero: Enormous digital clock (Barlow Condensed, huge size) on an abstract dark industrial background. Below clock: Shift status badge (e.g., 'En turno'). Main Body: Large split action buttons for 'Fichar Entrada' (success color) and 'Fichar Salida' (error color). Below that, a 2-column grid of quick actions: 'Ronda', 'Incidencia', 'Tareas'. No extra scroll needed.

screens.name: Naves (Sites)
screens.purpose: Manage and view the assigned warehouses/sites.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty map/building with text 'No hay naves asignadas' and 'Añadir Nave' button.

screens.layout: List of site cards. Each card uses the warehouse photo as a background, overlaid with a strict top-to-bottom dark scrim (transparent to ≥80% surfaceInverse). Site name in bold at the bottom of the card. A sticky FAB in brandPrimary at the bottom right to 'Añadir Nave'.

screens.name: Control Horario (Time Log)
screens.purpose: A chronological log of all actions taken during the shift.

states.empty: Empty state icon (clock) 'No hay registros en este turno'.

screens.layout: Vertical timeline layout. Each event (Entrada, Ronda iniciada, Incidencia reportada) is a compact surfaceSecondary card with a timestamp on the left. A sticky bottom container with a full-width 'Exportar a PDF / Excel' button.

screens.name: Reporte de Incidencia
screens.purpose: Fast capture of an anomaly or security issue.
screens.layout: Single-column form. Fields: 'Tipo de Incidencia' (Select), 'Nave / Ubicación' (Select), 'Descripción' (Multiline input). A large dashed-border area to 'Añadir Foto' (Camera trigger). Sticky bottom button 'Enviar Reporte'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Spanish language for all UI text, placeholders, and navigation.
NO BLUES OR PURPLES. The palette is strictly dark grays and safety orange/amber. Do not introduce default blue links or indigo buttons.
The Dashboard clock must use the displayFontFamily ('Barlow Condensed') and be extremely prominent (font size > 48pt).
Use the 'bottom sticky CTA' pattern for major actions (Iniciar Turno, Exportar, Enviar Reporte). The button must live outside the ScrollView inside a fixed bottom container.
For the 'Naves' cards, you MUST overlay a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (`expo-linear-gradient`, transparent to ≥80% surfaceInverse) on top of the image before rendering text, ensuring contrast.
Do not use glassmorphism. This is a field ops utility app; use solid `surfaceSecondary` and `border` colors to establish hierarchy.
Implement haptic feedback (`expo-haptics`) on all key interactions: Fichar Entrada/Salida, starting a round, and submitting an incident.
